state.tooltip: Realm divide set to 'Disabled'. All factions in the campaign will not gain any fame points from conquered settlements. This will stop realm divide from happening before conquering Kyoto, but this is not the intended gameplay experience.

state.title: gem_0
state.tooltip: Realm divide set to 'Disabled'. All factions in the campaign will not gain any fame points from conquered settlements. This will stop realm divide from happening, but this is not the intended gameplay experience.

state.title: bos_0
state.tooltip: Realm divide set to 'Disabled'. All factions in the campaign will not gain any fame points from conquered settlements. This will stop realm divide from happening, but this is not the intended gameplay experience and may render some end-game content inaccessible.

state.title: bos_1
state.tooltip: With realm divide difficulty set to Easy, you get less fame points for each settlement captured, and other factions get more. This will delay the inevitable, but might slow down access to some end-game content.

state.title: bos_3
state.tooltip: With realm divide difficulty set to Hard, you get more fame points for each settlement captured, and other factions get less. This will speed up the realm divide, making the campaign slightly harder as a result.
